3.3.3.1-f1.accuracy_reason: The wording (fons cladium, seminarium delictorum) is from Cyprian's De zelo et livore, where zelus is envy. The note is properly hedged, and its point about 'murders' is right.

3.3.3.1-f3.accuracy_reason: Cicero, De officiis 2.25: Alexander of Pherae was killed by his wife Thebe propter pelicatus suspicionem.
